name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width, unrack, lower bar smoothly to mid-chest, drive up to lockout while squeezing pecs.
form_cues: Retract shoulder blades, keep feet flat on floor, drive through heels.
common_mistakes: Bouncing bar off chest, flaring elbows out at 90 degrees.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-degree incline. Press dumbbells upward from shoulder height to full arm extension.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked over elbows, arc dumbbells toward center at top.
common_mistakes: Setting incline too high (>45 degrees shifts focus to front delts).

name: Cable Crossover Fly
instructions: Set pulleys to shoulder height. Bring handles together in a hugging motion with a slight bend in elbows.
form_cues: Maintain constant elbow angle, squeeze chest hard for 1 second at peak contraction.
common_mistakes: Pressing the weight instead of flying.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip parallel dip bars, lean torso forward 30 degrees, lower body until shoulders pass elbows, drive up.
form_cues: Keep chin tucked, lean forward to target lower chest.
common_mistakes: Staying completely upright shifts load to triceps.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand over bar, hinge at hips, grip bar shoulder-width, lock core, pull slack, drive feet into ground to lockout.
form_cues: Neutral spine, bar remains against shins/thighs throughout lift.
common_mistakes: Rounding lower back, hyperextending at top.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip wide bar, pull down smoothly to upper collarbone while driving elbows down into side ribs.
form_cues: Lead movement with elbows, slight lean back (10 degrees).
common_mistakes: Swinging torso excessively, pulling behind neck.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge torso to 45 degrees, pull barbell to lower chest/navel squeezing shoulder blades together.
form_cues: Keep knees soft, brace abdominal wall tight.
common_mistakes: Standing up during reps, shrugging shoulders.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright on bench, pull handle to belly button, squeeze mid-back, control stretch returning forward.
form_cues: Chest out, shoulder blades retracted at contraction.
common_mistakes: Excessive lumbar rounding during stretch phase.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Position barbell on upper traps, unrack, sit hips back and squat below parallel, drive up through mid-foot.
form_cues: Knees track in line with toes, chest up throughout movement.
common_mistakes: Knees caving inward (valgus collapse), shallow depth.

name: Leg Press Machine
instructions: Place feet hip-width on platform, release safety latches, lower sled to 90-degree knee bend, press back up.
form_cues: Keep lower back flat against seat back rest, do not lock out knees aggressively.
common_mistakes: Lifting tailbone off seat at bottom of movement.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs, hinge hips backward with soft knee bend, lower weights along shins until hamstring stretch, contract glutes to stand.
form_cues: Think pushing wall back with hips.
common_mistakes: Bending knees too much turning it into a squat.

name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Stand tall, rest bar on collarbone, press bar vertically over head clearing face, lockout with head through arms.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes and core tight to stabilize spine.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, raise arms out sideways to 90 degrees with pinkies slightly higher than thumbs.
form_cues: Lead with elbows, avoid swinging torso.

name: Cable Face Pull
secondary_muscles: Rear Delts, External Rotators, Upper Back
instructions: Attach rope to upper cable, pull handles toward eye level while spreading hands apart.
form_cues: External rotation at peak contraction (biceps pose).
common_mistakes: Pulling to stomach instead of face.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand upright, grip straight bar, curl upward keeping elbows pinned at ribs.
form_cues: Full extension at bottom, squeeze biceps at top.

name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
instructions: Attach rope attachment to high cable, push down spreading rope ends apart at lockout.
form_cues: Keep upper arms stationary at side of body.
